analyst_response.spl_code:
search index=pgcil_soc sourcetype=pgcil:auth earliest=-24h latest=now
| eval src_ip_norm=lower(coalesce(src_ip, "unknown"))
| stats
    count as event_count
    earliest(_time) as first_seen_epoch
    latest(_time) as last_seen_epoch
    by src_ip_norm
| eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen_epoch, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), last_seen=strftime(last_seen_epoch, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
| fields - first_seen_epoch last_seen_epoch
| sort - event_count
| head 100

assumptions: Multiple failed login attempts from the same source IP within a short time frame indicate a brute-force attack.
